summary: Frontend-only verification of the 3 changes: (A) Landowner paragraph now reads 'Own a plot in or around Hyderabad?' with other Ameenpur references intact (Ameenpur present 8x on Home). (B) Night is the default everywhere: /projects cards (card-night-image-<slug> has src, card-day-image-<slug> has no src initially, aria-pressed=true on Night), project detail hero uses elevation-night.webp, DayNightImage elevation switcher shows aria-pressed=true on Night, and the full-screen ElevationViewer opens with viewer-night-button aria-pressed=true. Manual Day/Night toggle on cards works (Day loads on click and switches). (C) Home hero is the automatic night crossfade slideshow: initial hero-elevation-image src is my-dream-skylark/elevation-night.webp; after 7.5s hero-slide-my-dream-nest becomes visible (opacity 1) with night src; after 15s hero-slide-my-dream-casa is visible with night src. Hero content (You Dream./We Build., paragraph, both CTAs, 'Ameenpur, Hyderabad · Since 2020') is visible on both desktop (1920) and mobile (390). Performance: ZERO 'elevation-day' image requests fired on initial Home load, slideshow (~15s) load, or /projects load. Only 1 day request fires exactly after clicking a Day toggle button. Regression: /projects/my-dream-aurelia (ongoing, Coming Soon) loads cleanly. No console errors on Home, /projects, /projects/my-dream-nest or /projects/my-dream-aurelia.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx: aria-hidden is set on non-active hero slides but their tags remain in the DOM with an empty alt only when i!==slide — good. Consider adding role='img' or leaving as-is (minor).
Home.jsx slideshow uses setInterval with dependency on `loaded` state — every image load re-creates the interval, which can subtly shift timing right after the first two loads. Non-blocking.

ProjectCard.jsx uses local mode state per card — this is fine, but note that clicking Day on one card and navigating to that project detail does NOT preserve mode; detail page always starts Night (this matches the requested behaviour).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 requested changes verified. Slideshow interval measured ~5.5s + 2s crossfade — confirmed order Skylark → Nest → Casa. Day images are correctly lazy: 0 network requests to elevation-day.webp anywhere on Home/Projects/Detail load; requests only start after user clicks a Day toggle.
